g.text: Figure 8. Validation: are al-Kawthar's hapax 'maximally bound'? No. Against the corpus's
430 once-occurring roots, ﺮﺤﻧ binds BELOW median (10th pct) and ﺮﺘﺑ is only moderate (66th).
The earlier 'maximally specific' reading is not supported; what survives is the single ﺮﺘﺑ–ﺀﻦﺷ tie.
